reason: I've never heard of Claro and there's nothing here about reviews or test results, just a creator I follow saying it's good. On $26k a year I'm not putting almost $68 down plus a subscription on a brand that could be a rebranded knockoff.
objection: No reviews and no proof the filter actually does what it says. 'Supplier rates it at 150 L' isn't independent testing, and I don't want to get locked into a filter subscription for something that might not even taste better than hotel tap water.
would_change_my_mind: Hundreds of real customer reviews plus independent lab test results showing what the filter removes.
